title: Lightly Emulsified Thai Noodles Pad Thai
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Thai dish featuring flaked almonds and a lightly emulsified sauce, served on a slate tile. This weeknight Thai dish has a bitter and glassy-jelly texture.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium heat.
Add the flaked almonds and cook until lightly toasted.
Add the rice noodles and cook until they are slightly softened.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tamarind paste, palm sugar, soy sauce, and lime juice.
Pour the sauce over the noodles and almonds, and stir to combine.
Push the noodles to one side of the pan, then crack in the eggs and scramble them until cooked through.
Mix the eggs with the noodles and sauce.
Add the bean sprouts and salt, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the sauce has lightly emulsified.
Serve the pad thai on a slate tile, garnished with additional flaked almonds if desired.
